summary: This manuscript rigorously upgrades Chandrasekaran's null-cone quantization of four-dimensional Lorentzian gravity. It proves exact O(G_N^4) higher-loop collapse and C0 Planckian cusps for the graviton pair amplitude real part (Theorem 1), establishes an all-moments Beta(alpha,1) law with a universal Golden-Ratio variance ceiling Var <= phi^{-5} and a Matter-Content Sign Barrier c_mass > -1/2 that forbids pure SU(5), SO(10), and E8 gauge groups (Theorem 2), and derives optimal O(C^{1/4}) focusing prefactors alongside exponential UV shear cutoffs (Theorem 3). All claims are fully machine-checked in Lean 4 and verified via exact-rational AST-audited Python scripts.
